description: This file contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to add serialization support in the Orleans framework. It defines methods to register serializers, type resolvers, codecs, and other related components used in Orleans serialization infrastructure.

classes.name: ServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods to add serialization support to IServiceCollection.

classes.name: ConfigurationContext
classes.description: Holds context information for serializer configuration within IServiceCollection.

classes.name: SerializerBuilder
classes.description: Implements ISerializerBuilder to allow fluent configuration of serializer components.

classes.name: ActivatorHolder<T>
classes.description: Holds and lazy-initializes an IActivator<T> service.

classes.name: FieldCodecHolder<TField>
classes.description: Holds and lazy-initializes an IFieldCodec<TField> service.

classes.name: BaseCodecHolder<TField>
classes.description: Holds and lazy-initializes an IBaseCodec<TField> service, constrained to class types.

classes.name: ValueSerializerHolder<TField>
classes.description: Holds and lazy-initializes an IValueSerializer<TField> for value types.

classes.name: CopierHolder<T>
classes.description: Holds and lazy-initializes an IDeepCopier<T> service.

classes.name: BaseCopierHolder<T>
classes.description: Holds and lazy-initializes an IBaseCopier<T> service, constrained to class types.

classes.name: IServiceHolder<T>
classes.description: Interface representing a holder for a service instance.

methods.name: AddSerializer
methods.description: Extension method to add Orleans serialization support to an IServiceCollection, registering core components and optional configuration.

methods.name: GetFromServices
methods.description: Retrieves a singleton service implementation instance from IServiceCollection if already registered.
